list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete, approximately coplanar Gd4 cage bridged by eight μ-ethanethiolates and one μ4-ethanethiolate. Each Gd has a terminal bis(trimethylsilyl)amide and a highly distorted six-coordinate GdNS5 environment; the article describes the Gd structure as closely analogous to the detailed Tb structure.

synthesis.procedure: A thf solution of ethanethiol was added at room temperature to an equimolar amount of [{(Me3Si)2N}3Gd(μ-Cl)Li(thf)3] in thf. The mixture was stirred for 4 h, the thf was evaporated, and the residue was extracted with toluene. The concentrated filtrate was stored at 4 °C for 2 days.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The anion contains four coplanar, crystallographically unique but chemically similar Tb(III) centers. Eight μ-ethanethiolates bridge the cage, and a μ4-ethanethiolate binds all four Tb centers with its sulfur approximately 0.95 Å out of the Tb4 plane. Each Tb also bears one terminal bis(trimethylsilyl)amide and has a highly distorted octahedral TbNS5 coordination environment with very low local symmetry.

synthesis.procedure: A thf solution of ethanethiol was added at room temperature to an equimolar amount of [{(Me3Si)2N}3Tb(μ-Cl)Li(thf)3] in thf. The mixture was stirred for 4 h, the thf was evaporated, and the residue was extracted with toluene. The concentrated filtrate was stored at 4 °C for 2 days.

properties.summary: The bulk compound 3 is a single-molecule magnet with pronounced temperature- and frequency-dependent relaxation. Two processes are observed: thermally activated relaxation and low-temperature quantum tunneling of magnetization, the latter reduced by a 2000 G dc field. Magnetic measurements are reported for [Li(thf)4][3] after drying, whereas the deposited crystal contains one lattice thf.
